description: Swap Quote. Calls only GET /v4/trading/swap-quote and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching Solana swap quotes. Returns expected output, price impact, slippage bounds, and full route plan for any token pair.

amount.description: Amount of input token to swap (in UI units, e.g., 0.1 for 0.1 SOL)
